name: Kuala Lumpur Standard Chartered Marathon (KLSCM)
short_description: KLSCM is a full-marathon event held on 4 October 2026 at Dataran Merdeka, Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, with registration open now.
ai_summary: The Kuala Lumpur Standard Chartered Marathon (KLSCM) is a full-marathon event taking place on 4 October 2026 at Dataran Merdeka in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. faqs.question: When is the Kuala Lumpur Standard Chartered Marathon (KLSCM) taking place?
faqs.answer: The Kuala Lumpur Standard Chartered Marathon is scheduled to take place on 4 October 2026. The event will be held at Dataran Merdeka in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, and is organized by Dirigo Events Sdn Bhd. Registration for the race is currently open for interested runners.

faqs.question: What distances can I run at KLSCM?
faqs.answer: KLSCM offers four distance categories for participants to choose from: a full marathon of 42.195km, a half marathon of 21.1km, a 10km race, and a shorter 5km race. This range allows both experienced marathoners and casual runners to take part in the event.

faqs.question: How much does it cost to register for KLSCM?
faqs.answer: Registration pricing for the Kuala Lumpur Standard Chartered Marathon starts at MYR 150. This price range applies to the event overall, though specific costs may vary depending on which distance category, such as the marathon, half marathon, 10km, or 5km, a runner chooses to enter.
